reviews.text: Heather is so absolutely wonderful to work with! She did both mine and my sister’s senior photos and now my wedding! Our photos are breathtaking. She has a way of making people feel comfortable and like they can truly be themselves.
reviews.author: Kaylin S.

reviews.text: Great experience, amazing pictures, and most important professionalism from Heather! I would recommend her studio for any event you're facing. You will be treated like a royalty!
reviews.author: Ivy

reviews.text: Had a fantastic experience with Heather at Dreaming Tree Studios! Heather was very prompt and professional with all correspondence leading up to a big extended family photo session and everything afterwards.
reviews.author: Jillian T.
